_layout: Generated module, byte for byte (lines joined with \n, file ends with one \n):
<each import line of the block, in order, as written with trailing spaces and tabs removed>
Indentation is 4 spaces for `Test.concat` and 8 for the `[`, `,` and `]` lines. The first case opens with `[ `, the others with `, `.
<Answer>: answerFile without `.elm`, `/` replaced by `.` (Main.elm -> Main, Foo/Bar.elm -> Foo.Bar).
<name>: the R5 name inside an Elm string literal: `\` becomes `\\` and `"` becomes `\"`; every other character is copied as is.
expr and value are the text on each side of the operator with spaces and tabs at the ends removed, after the inline comment is cut.
Cases keep source order. `module` has every case; `publicModule` only the cases of {public}/{example} regions (same imports), and is null when there is none.
`error.line` is the line of the source (from 1) that the error points to, or null for `no-cases`. `error.kind` is one of: invalid-line, late-import, duplicate-name, no-cases, empty-region.
duplicate-name points to the second case with the name; empty-region points to the item line of the annotation.

entries.name: author guide example: imports, {example}, {public}, private region, inline comment, ~=, negative argument
entries.input:
import Dict

-- mdq: [0] {example} Exemplos do enunciado
collatzLength 5 ==> 6
collatzLength -42 ==> 0 -- negativos têm comprimento zero

-- mdq: [+2] {public} Média
media [ 7, 8 ] ~= 7.5

-- mdq: [+3] Sequências longas
collatzLength 27 ==> 112
entries.module:
module Examples0 exposing (tests)

import Expect
import Test
import Main exposing (..)
import Dict


tests : Test.Test
tests =
    Test.concat
        [ Test.test "collatzLength 5 ==> 6" (\_ -> Expect.equal (6) (collatzLength 5))
        , Test.test "collatzLength -42 ==> 0 (negativos têm comprimento zero)" (\_ -> Expect.equal (0) (collatzLength -42))
        , Test.test "media [ 7, 8 ] ~= 7.5" (\_ -> Expect.within (Expect.AbsoluteOrRelative 1.0e-9 1.0e-6) (7.5) (media [ 7, 8 ]))
        , Test.test "collatzLength 27 ==> 112" (\_ -> Expect.equal (112) (collatzLength 27))
        ]
entries.publicModule:

        , Test.test "media [ 7, 8 ] ~= 7.5" (\_ -> Expect.within (Expect.AbsoluteOrRelative 1.0e-9 1.0e-6) (7.5) (media [ 7, 8 ]))

entries.name: no annotation: implicit item, every case private; literals hide -- and ==>; char with a quote; nested answer file
entries.input:
String.length "a -- b" ==> 6
String.length "x ==> y" ==> 7 -- seta
f '"' ==> "\"" -- aspas
entries.module:
module Examples2 exposing (tests)

import Expect
import Test
import Foo.Bar exposing (..)


tests : Test.Test
tests =
    Test.concat
        [ Test.test "String.length \"a -- b\" ==> 6" (\_ -> Expect.equal (6) (String.length "a -- b"))
        , Test.test "String.length \"x ==> y\" ==> 7 (seta)" (\_ -> Expect.equal (7) (String.length "x ==> y"))
        , Test.test "f '\"' ==> \"\\\"\" (aspas)" (\_ -> Expect.equal ("\"") (f '"'))
        ]
